title: Canonical RIM constructions on mechanical forecasts - R2-B GLS-ICC (primary), R2-A FL3-V/P (secondary)
inherits: R1 forecasts carried under the INDETERMINATE gate (R1_GATE_ADDENDUM_INDETERMINATE.md). Both RI and EP are parallel inputs; the rule below resolves their disagreement in advance (red-team fh-20260807-090 ask).

r2b_gls_icc.goal: Per-firm implied cost of equity r_e solving GLS eq.5/6 with mechanical FY1-FY3 forecasts, ROE fade to industry median, clean-surplus book roll-forward. Outputs firm_icc, firm_icc_minus_rf, firm_icc_percentile per (firm, origin).

forecast_input.source: R1 fitted mechanical models applied per firm at each origin, taus 1..3.
forecast_input.ri_vs_ep_rule_precommitted: Compute ICC under BOTH the RI and the EP forecast paths (firm_icc_ri, firm_icc_ep). The primary reported ICC is the RI-path value (the canonical residual-income forecast). The EP-path ICC is reported beside it as sensitivity. If the two disagree on a downstream verdict, the artifact must show both and the disagreement is recorded, not silently resolved by whichever was computed first.

r2b_gls_icc.book_roll_forward: B_{t+i} = B_{t+i-1} + FEPS_{t+i}*(1-k), per-share, from current book B_t = most-relevant annual book / shares_basis (GLS:732-736).

payout_k.rule: k = trailing-twelve-month dividends-per-share at the origin / most-recent-fiscal-year EPS, clamped [0,1] (GLS:714-731).
payout_k.negative_earnings: If EPS <= 0: k = trailing-DPS / (0.06 * total-assets-per-share), clamped [0,1] (GLS:726-731).
payout_k.non_payer: If trailing dividends are zero: k = 0 (book rolls forward at full forecast earnings).
payout_k.missing_dividends: If the dividend fetch failed for a symbol (no data at all): excluded from ICC and counted. Declared deviation: trailing-TTM dividends at the origin proxy the most-recent-fiscal-year dividends (exact fiscal-year dividends not assembled).
payout_k.basis_note: Yahoo dividends are split-adjusted to today's basis, matching the today-basis per-share earnings/book (shares_basis). Trailing-TTM DPS at the origin and most-recent-fiscal-year EPS are therefore on the same basis.

roe_fade.fade_years: Years 4-12: FROE linearly interpolates from FROE_3 to the industry target ROE, reaching it exactly at year 12 (9 equal steps; GLS:526-541, verified GLS:2610).
roe_fade.target_roe: Industry median of annual ROE (aggregate E / book) over the trailing 5 fiscal years ending before the origin, profitable-firm-years only (positive E), per industry (GLS:627-639).
roe_fade.industry_scheme: SIC 2-digit major groups, a DECLARED DEVIATION from GLS's FF-48 (no SIC->FF48 crosswalk is available locally; SIC is the measured industry field). The deviation and its direction are stated in the artifact.
roe_fade.thin_industry_fallback: If an industry has fewer than 3 profitable firm-years in the trailing window, the target falls back to the market-wide median ROE (declared).

r2b_gls_icc.terminal: GLS eq.6 convention: TV = (FROE_T - r)*B_{T-1} / (r*(1+r)^(T-1)), T=12 (exponent T-1 per GLS:610-616; the LM (1+r)^T variant is NOT used).
r2b_gls_icc.solver: Bisection on r in [0.001, 0.60], tolerance 1e-9 on price equality, max 200 iterations (validated: reproduces GLS worked example GM r=13.94%). Non-convergence -> firm excluded and counted; bracket endpoints NOT reported as ICC.
r2b_gls_icc.risk_free: firm_icc_minus_rf = firm_icc - 10-year Treasury yield at the origin (repo data/macro/fred-banking-daily.json DGS10, last obs <= origin).
r2b_gls_icc.percentile: firm_icc_percentile = cross-sectional percentile of firm_icc within the origin.
r2b_gls_icc.plausibility_guard_side_precommitted: Guards apply to INPUTS only (base-year eps/book/dividend sanity), NOT to the solved ICC outcome. No outcome-side truncation (red-team fh-20260807-090: guarding the outcome is target-truncation). ICC values are reported as solved; implausible solved ICC (e.g. outside [0,0.60]) is a convergence artifact and counted, not silently dropped from the cross-section.

r2a_fl3_vp.status: SECONDARY and under-specified - the industry-specific cost of equity has NO local anchor ([FL98-not-on-disk]: no local text describes an industry-level non-fitted discount rate; GLS/LM solve per-firm r; the trailing industry risk-premium estimator is unanchored). R2-A is implemented only if a defensible discount rate is pre-committed; otherwise it is deferred and the artifact says so.
r2a_fl3_vp.construction_if_implemented: GLS eq.5/6 mechanics with the explicit horizon cut at T=3 (no fade), forecast inputs mechanical, V/P = V_t / P_t (spec draft section B.1).

sample.origins: The five R1 origins, June 30 of 2019-2023.
sample.universe: R1 retained universe (447 symbols), further reduced by dividend availability and positive-book requirement (GLS needs non-negative book for the fade target; LM ICCGLS screen).
sample.filters_precommitted: price > $1 (FL98/BR stability filter), non-negative book, non-negative shares_basis, dividend data present. Exclusions counted per filter.

aggregation.rule: Per origin report: cap-weighted mean, cap-weighted median, and trimmed-mean (5% each tail) of firm_icc and firm_icc_minus_rf, with the cap-weighted median pre-designated PRIMARY. Declared deviation: GLS itself uses equal-weighted means (GLS:1185-1199); the owner directive specifies cap-weighted - both the deviation and the equal-weighted values are reported for the record.

verification_anchors.solver: Must reproduce GLS worked example GM: B0=17.01, FY1=6.75, FY2=7.73, FY3=8.29, k=0.196, target ROE=0.160 -> r=13.94% (already passing in r2-gls-solver.mjs self-test).
verification_anchors.sanity: Cross-sectional firm_icc should be predominantly positive and in a plausible band (~5-25%); the artifact reports the distribution, not a pass/fail.

prohibitions: No post-result choice of discount rate, fade window, industry scheme, or solver bracket.
No outcome-side truncation of solved ICC.
No analyst-data input (mechanical forecasts only; analyst PIT is R4's question).
No public number republication; quarantine untouched.

inputs_confirmed.forecasts: R1 RI and EP fitted models per (firm, origin, tau)
inputs_confirmed.solver_validation: reproduces GLS worked example GM r=13.94%

amendments.change: Drop fp from annual-fact selection entirely. Annual facts are identified by form in (10-K,10-K/A) PLUS duration (end-start) in [300,400] days; fp is NOT used. Rationale (red-team measurement): SEC tags some ANNUAL income facts fp=Q4 (not FY) on the original filing, and the fp=FY-tagged version sometimes appears only in a LATER filing - so an fp=FY filter silently skips the original and prefers a later restatement (a PIT hazard, 0.2% of firm-periods = 18/7665 across 13 firms). Duration+form is what actually identifies an annual fact; fp adds nothing and sometimes subtracts the original.
amendments.executed_consistency: VERIFIED the R1/R2 code (annualDuration) never enforced fp (grep: no .fp reference in r1-forecast.mjs or r2-gls-icc.mjs). Therefore ALL executed runs (R1 gate, R2-B GLS-ICC committed 17722e0266) already used the fp-agnostic (safe) selection - this amendment aligns the criteria TEXT with what was executed; NO re-run is required and NO result changes. This closes the restatement-preference hazard.
